schemeContent.briefDescription: This scheme aims to recognize high-level maritime contributions by providing recognition to individuals with sustained excellence.

children.text: The "Sagar Samman Award- Sagar Samman Award for Excellence" scheme has been launched by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways under the Directorate General of Shipping, Government of India, aims to recognize consistently high-quality contributions in the maritime sector. Under this scheme, a prestigious award is provided to individuals demonstrating excellence in leadership, innovation, and sector development.
